# Proofed

> Proofed is a managed proofreading and editing agency offering professional content quality assurance across business, academic, publishing, and specialized industry sectors.

Proofed provides expert editing and proofreading services with a team of 750+ professional editors. The company specializes in managed editing solutions for businesses, individuals, students, and authors, with particular expertise in AI-generated content editing, financial services, legal documents, and eLearning materials.

## Core Services

- [Business Proofreading Services](https://proofed.co.uk): Proofed homepage: expert managed proofreading and editing services.
- [Expert Proofreaders for Business](https://proofed.co.uk/services/proofreading): Professional proofreading services for business content quality assurance.
- [Editing Services For Business](https://proofed.co.uk/services/copy-editing): Copy editing services with 750+ professional editors for business content.
- [Document Formatting Services](https://proofed.co.uk/services/formatting): Professional document formatting services complementing proofreading.

## AI Content & Fact-Checking

- [AI-Generated Content Editing Services](https://proofed.co.uk/services/ai-content-editing): Human editing for AI-generated content quality control and brand protection.
- [Fact-Checking for AI-Generated Content](https://proofed.co.uk/services/ai-fact-checking): Fact-checking service ensuring validity and accuracy in AI-generated content.

## Industry-Specific Services

- [Content Editing Services for Marketing & Agencies](https://proofed.co.uk/marketing-advertising): Content editing for marketing teams, agencies, and SEO optimization.
- [E-Learning Editing & QA Services](https://proofed.co.uk/elearning): Specialized eLearning and courseware editing for educational content.
- [Market Research & Intelligence Report Editing](https://proofed.co.uk/market-intelligence): Market research report editing and intelligence content optimization.
- [Expert Financial Proofreaders](https://proofed.co.uk/financial-services): Specialized financial document proofreading with ISO 27001 compliance.
- [Legal Proofreading Services](https://proofed.co.uk/legal): Legal document proofreading for law firms ensuring compliance and accuracy.
- [Insurance Document Editing Services](https://proofed.co.uk/insurance): Specialist insurance document editing and proofreading services.
- [Publishers & Media Proofreading](https://proofed.co.uk/publishing-media): Publishing and media industry proofreading with narrative voice preservation.
- [Grant Editing for Competitive Proposals](https://proofed.co.uk/grant-proposals): Grant proposal editing for competitive funding applications.
